PrivacyPolicyIntro: At Arena Fitness, we prioritize the protection and confidentiality of our gym members' and administrators' data. This privacy policy details how we collect, store, and process physical fitness records, subscription details, and login information.
DataCollectionText: We collect account credentials, payment records, gym check-in timestamps, and membership subscription details to provide seamless operations inside the gym facility.
SecurityComplianceText: All subscription transactions and membership status databases are encrypted and protected under strict security guidelines. We do not sell or share fitness tracking metrics with third-party providers.
